doc.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998

chapter: Jump Town and the Ventura band
title: Jackie's brief stint as girl singer and the Kai Winding announcement
summary: Ventura's earlier lineup, Jackie's short job at the Sherman Hotel and College Inn, and the announcer mistaking her for Kai Winding.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: You were married at this time?
No, no, no. No we weren’t.
Okay. But they definitely wanted the two of you.

They wanted the two of us yeah. Because see he had been traveling at that time with Buddy Stewart and Kai Winding on trombone and Shelly Manne, and Lou Stein on piano, and Bob Carter on bass. And so they had Buddy singing ballads and doing some things with voice-horn things, with Charlie. And I was just the girl singer at first, for a few minutes, because he had a job at the Sherman Hotel and the College Inn and they had airtime and they wanted a girl singer. But you know something funny happened. I just recalled this. That the announcer was not at the club, he was in the studio. The band played for dancing, but we also did some show things and special material. So from the studio the guy one night said, “and now, a vocal by the lovely Kai Winding.” They thought Kai Winding was the woman, and my name being Jackie, Jackie Cain, sounded more like the guy. So he kind of got it mixed up.
Well you confuse the issue. This is before we joined forces with Charlie.
Yeah. Well just for that one job. And then Roy was writing the arrangements for me and so then finally he wanted us to work together.
